label: Population dynamics
text: BI.O.A5.1 Population dynamics. Exponential growth dN/dt = rN holds for constant per-capita rate r with unlimited resources and no structure. Logistic growth dN/dt = rN(1 − N/K) adds a fixed carrying capacity K and linear density dependence. K holds only in a stated setting. Human demography is owned by MS.O.A5.

warrant.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Pseudoreplication; scale mismatch; confounded gradients; detection bias
